lines.text: Confession: I've known about tomorrow since lunch. I waited until eight for the drama.
I've watched tomorrow twice already. The middle drags.
Somewhere a TV forecaster needs a whole green screen to say this. I am the screen.
Tomorrow, a whole night early. Anything else this fast would be a scam.
This forecast is final. The weather can appeal in the morning.
Somewhere, someone is checking tomorrow in three different apps until one says what they want.
Today and tomorrow, side by side. They're not on speaking terms.
I peeked at tomorrow. I'm not proud of it. Okay, a little proud.
Every evening I tell people about tomorrow. Not one has ever asked about my day.
Seeing tomorrow a night early is the closest I get to time travel. It's mostly paperwork.
A fortune teller would charge forty dollars for this and throw in a tall, dark stranger.
Out there it's still today. In here, I've moved on.
The evening news makes everyone wait for the weather. I lead with it.
Tomorrow's weather, the night before. The weather itself won't find out until morning.
Tomorrow: as shown. No returns, no exchanges.
Tomorrow can't sneak up on me. I never look away.
Between us, tomorrow tried to change its mind twice today. I didn't let it.
Every tomorrow for four billion years has come with weather. Somehow it's still a conversation starter.
Memo to tomorrow: you've been drawn. Don't make me redraw you.
I rehearse tomorrow all evening. The weather never shows up to rehearsal.
Bakers get up at four to get tomorrow ready. I had mine done by eight.
Tomorrow looks its best the night before. Nobody's complained about it yet.
Delivery notice: one tomorrow, arriving overnight. No signature required.
Confession: tomorrow's outfit took me longer than today's. I wanted it to look effortless.
I show you tomorrow a night early. Frankly, you need the head start.
You read tomorrow's forecast like a farmer. You've never grown anything but tired.
A whole night's notice, and tomorrow you'll still look like that.
Notice: tomorrow's outfit has been chosen for you. Your input was considered and rejected.
Tomorrow's outfit was drawn on a better-looking model. Results may vary.
Tomorrow's weather is taken care of. Tomorrow's hair is on you.
Looking ahead to tomorrow already? Today went that well, huh?
Tomorrow's a fresh start. For the weather.
Tomorrow took me two seconds to draw. Your face will take you most of the morning.
I've picked tomorrow's outfit. Your personality, I can't help with.
I've seen tomorrow. You look tired in it.
Now you can start dreading tomorrow early. You're a natural.
Some people get ready the night before. You read about it on a screen.
You've seen tomorrow. It hasn't seen you yet. Lucky tomorrow.
Nobody changes overnight. You've tested that very thoroughly.
You think knowing the weather means tomorrow will go well. Adorable.
I can forecast all of tomorrow except you. Though I'd guess 'rough.'
You'll probably think about tomorrow's weather tonight. It won't think about you once.
This is more planning than anyone has ever put into your tomorrow. Including you.
You check tomorrow's weather in the evening to feel like a functioning adult. It's working, a little.
Notice: this forecast is for information only. It will not make you a morning person.
Somewhere a person your age has tomorrow planned down to the minute. Try not to think about them.
I've got tomorrow's weather ready. You've got tomorrow's excuses ready. We're both professionals.
You've read tomorrow's forecast. That's probably the most reading you'll do tonight.
